title: Gus and the Pig
lines: Gus got a pup and a pig.
The pup can tug. The pig can dig.
The pig dug and dug in the mud.
The pig dug up a tin mug!
"It is not a nut," said Gus.
A nut is in the mug!
Gus and the pup pat the pig.

questions.ask: What did the pig dig up?
questions.listenFor: A tin mug. The story says it. If your child is unsure, have them find the word mug and read that line again.

questions.ask: Was Gus happy at the end? How can you tell?
questions.listenFor: Yes — he and the pup patted the pig. Listen for the pat, and for the nut turning up inside the mug after all.

questions.ask: Tell me what the pig did, from the first dig to the last.
questions.listenFor: Dug in the mud, dug up a tin mug, and a nut was inside it. Lines four to seven, in order.
